description: This TypeScript file defines an Angular component named 'TodoItemComponent', which is a presentational component for displaying and interacting with a single todo item. It includes input properties, output events for toggling completion and removal, and a template with styling.

classes.name: TodoItemComponent
classes.description: A presentational Angular component for a single todo item, enabling toggling completion and removal through emitted events.

methods.name: onToggle
methods.description: Emits the 'toggle' event with the todo's ID when the checkbox is changed.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Emits the 'remove' event with the todo's ID when the Remove button is clicked.
